definitions.explanation: The sharp report made by a firearm being discharged. Often used in news reports, crime descriptions, and witness accounts of hearing distant gunfire.

examples.japanese: {銃声|じゅうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえた→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
{遠|とお}く⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{銃声|じゅうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{響|ひび}いた→響く：00099_hibiku⟧。
examples.english: A gunshot rang out in the distance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧、⟦{連続|れんぞく}した→連続する：22173_renzokusuru⟧{銃声|じゅうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いて→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通報|つうほう}→通報：14318_tsuuhou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Late at night, residents were startled by repeated gunshots and reported it to the police.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{銃|じゅう}→銃：10463_juu⟧ (gun) + {声|せい} (voice, sound). Here {声|せい} takes the sense of a characteristic sound rather than a human voice.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {銃声|じゅうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧: to hear a gunshot
- {銃声|じゅうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{響|ひび}く→響く：00099_hibiku⟧: a gunshot rings out
- {銃声|じゅうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}り{響|ひび}く→鳴り響く：09125_narihibiku⟧: gunshots reverberate
- ⟦{一発|いっぱつ}→一発：08895_ippatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{銃声|じゅうせい}: a single gunshot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {発砲音|はっぽうおん}: discharge sound — more technical, used in police/military reports
- ⟦{爆発音|ばくはつおん}→爆発音：28327_bakuhatsuon⟧: explosion sound — for larger, broader blasts
- ⟦{銃撃|じゅうげき}{戦|せん}→銃撃戦：23581_juugekisen⟧: gun battle, shootout — the event, not the sound
